name: entscheidsuche
title: entscheidsuche-mcp
description: MCP server for Swiss court decisions and case law from entscheidsuche.ch. Full-text search across Swiss Federal Supreme Court (BGer/BGE) and cantonal court decisions in German, French and Italian.

skills.name: Search Swiss case law
skills.description: Full-text search across Swiss court decisions and case law.

skills.name: Search by case number
skills.description: Exact lookup of Swiss case numbers, docket references and BGE citations.

skills.name: Fetch document
skills.description: Retrieve a single decision together with its full text.

skills.name: List court hierarchy
skills.description: List cantons, courts and chambers with counts.

skills.name: List facets
skills.description: Localized facet tree for courts and jurisdictions.
